eloT_IvSaOI.description:
Follow Olu: https://www.instagram.com/oluokiemute/

Watch the extended 52 minute version of this video by joining my patreon community:  https://bit.ly/PaulieBPatreon

Olu's Gear: 
Nikon F100 (https://shrsl.com/4kp32)
w/ 28mm f/2.8 NIKKOR AIS (https://shrsl.com/4kp33)
Hasselblad 500CM (https://shrsl.com/4kp34)
w/ 50mm f/4 Distagon CFi (https://shrsl.com/4kp35)

--
Are you looking for a film lab? I suggest joining Nice Film Club for their innovative platform and outstanding customer support: 
https://bit.ly/NiceFilmClub
https://bit.ly/NiceFilmClub
https://bit.ly/NiceFilmClub

--
Support the channel by buying my latest zine: 
https://bit.ly/NOTASWEKNOWIT_ORDER


--
business inquiry? email me here: contact@paulbaldonado.com
My IG: https://www.instagram.com/paulie.b/


--
Gear used to create this video: 
Video: DJI Osmo Pocket 3 (https://amzn.to/3R6Vr7t)
